name: Kan'in Tokkyuu Michishio
source:
A rumor spreads among young people that if a person gets on "that" train, he/she will disappear.... Most of them don't believe it, but it exists.... It's called Michishio. Michishio was invented to train young girls and make them into sex slaves. At first sight, the train is completely the same as a normal train. However, it shows its true self once in a few months. The girls who get on the train are severely trained and become sex slaves.... Seiji is a train conductor. He can do whatever he wants to the girls on the train since he has a special training ability. And another Michishio now departs.... 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110614/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1010677]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation: 在年轻人中流传着一个谣言——如果坐上"那辆"列车，就会消失……大多数人并不相信，但它确实存在……它名叫"满潮"。满潮是专门为了调教年轻女孩、将她们变成性奴而制造的列车。乍一看，它与普通列车完全一样。然而，每隔几个月，它就会露出真面目。登上这辆车的女孩会被严厉调教，最终沦为性奴……清二是这辆列车的列车长。他拥有特殊调教能力，可以对车上的女孩为所欲为。又一辆"满潮"出发了……\n\n[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110614/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1010677]ErogeShop[/url]]
